gcrosshair_params89 ABI 3 outline validation

- Builds with: -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror
- Parameter unit test: gcrosshair_params89 ABI3 outline: OK
- Shape unit test: gcrosshair_params89 shapes: OK
- Forbidden allocation/type scan: no malloc/realloc/calloc/free or real types
  in C/H implementation files.
- Resolves normal/aim/fire/hit/disabled, color policy, vector/image/hybrid,
  legacy gap spread and shape-size spread.
- Shape coverage: circle, square, diamond, chevrons, hexagon, brackets and
  open triangle, side masks and centered trace breaks.
- ABI 3 outline setter and resolver propagation tested.
